data.narrative:
Genesis AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $105M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of nine peers—one public (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private companies including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics—though narrow peer comparables proved insufficient for reliable median-based triangulation.

Given the absence of three or more same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers, the Peer-Median method was not applicable. The analysis therefore relies on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. Using the $105M total raised as a valuation proxy, this method implies a post-money valuation of $262M. A sensitivity range accounting for ±15% variance around this central estimate yields a low of $223M and a high of $302M.

The triangulated range of $223M–$302M (median $262M) is supported by a single methodological pillar and should be weighted accordingly. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for Genesis AI's specific risk profile and market conditions, as well as the limited ability to cross-validate against peer trading multiples or recent funding round pricing. Additional comparable data or internal milestone-based assessment would strengthen conviction in this range.
